usage: 椅 is a noun used to refer to a chair or seat, typically a single piece of furniture for sitting.
You can use 椅 to specify different kinds of chairs by adding adjectives or classifiers.
椅 can appear in singular or plural form, usually counted with 個 (go3) as a measure word.
It can be combined with other words to mean specific chairs, like 書椅 (desk chair).
椅 is common when talking about furniture arrangements or asking someone to sit.
